name: EPIC 210974526
description: A red giant in K2 campaign 4, 5.2 solar radii and 0.91 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 210974526 (K2 campaign 4): PARAM radius (solar radii) 5.240316 (16th-84th percentiles 5.080909-5.41656), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

mass.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 210974526 (K2 campaign 4): PARAM mass (solar masses) 0.911686 (16th-84th percentiles 0.846192-0.986891), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

temperature.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 210974526: APOGEE DR17 effective temperature 4907.9863 +/- 50 K (the catalogue's final uncertainty)

distance.source: Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, EPIC 210974526 (K2 campaign 4): PARAM asteroseismic distance (pc) 1887.460938 (16th-84th percentiles 1837.714844-1939.296875), MA09 pipeline with APOGEE DR17

color.reason: PARAM fits an extinction A_V = 0.72 mag toward this star (Khan et al. (2023), A&A 677, A21, k2_apo, AV-M), and the colour routes do not remove extinction; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red giant 1,888 parsecs away, 5 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations, recorded in K2 campaign 4, give 0.91 solar masses and 5.2 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,908 K at its surface.
